flows.label: Markets · actual data versus live orders
flows.what_works: A provider price/ticker/candle read was independently demonstrated on 2026-10-16 outside this prelaunch UI; the public UI supports locally imported candles
steps: Select market instrument and choose an approved public feed
Inspect venue, timestamps, depth, trade count and data freshness
Run read-only analysis or labeled paper simulation
Request account eligibility and separate risk-limited authorization for any live order
missing: Bounded risk policy and owner order grant
not_allowed: Claiming account fills from public-market trades
flows.receipt: Provider timestamp + read scope + instrument + data quality; paper test separately labeled

flows.label: 8x8 Studio · original 8:08 episode
flows.what_works: Original episode concepts, scripts, shots and captions may be drafted in the local preview; external finished rendering is provider-gated
steps: Create an original episode brief
Generate a timestamped storyboard and narration draft
Review music and asset permissions
Select an authorized renderer; export a locally owned draft when unavailable
missing: Authorized video renderer with available credits or local render capacity
allowed: Export a structured local production package
flows.receipt: Draft revision + asset/rights manifest + independent finished-video probe

flows.label: Creators · direct publishing workflow
flows.what_works: Channel-specific draft and preflight entries; no posting until provider OAuth, quota and delivery receipts
steps: Select target platforms and content rights
Compose channel-specific captions, format and media manifest
Check provider consent, API limits and active scopes
Stage user-approved posts and require confirmed remote platform receipt
flows.receipt: Per-destination platform post ID + permalink + timestamp + rights review

flows.label: FlashTM8 · coordinated agent missions
flows.what_works: Mission decomposition and route proposals can be displayed; no authenticated cross-agent roundtrip is implied
steps: Decompose one goal into source-bound subtasks
Match skill/tool roles with verified registry availability
Check tenant access, health, budget and owner STOP
Run bounded tasks only after actual agent/runtime leases and verify independent reply
allowed: Preserve task dependencies and evidence checklist
flows.receipt: Signed or source-bound task ID + agent identity + result + independent verification

flows.label: Access Rescue · missing tool or account
flows.what_works: Explain why an intended capability is unavailable and offer reversible alternatives without requesting secrets
steps: Identify exact feature and provider, never ask for the key in chat
Distinguish NOT_INSTALLED, UNREACHABLE, NOT_AUTHENTICATED, NOT_GRANTED, QUOTA_BLOCKED, JURISDICTION_BLOCKED
Show authorized native OAuth, on-device local custody or safe offline route
Create a nonsecret local action checklist with steps, owner authority and revoke path
missing: Deployed issuer/tenant authorization, when account access is needed
allowed: Recommend connection or safe local work
flows.receipt: Connection fingerprint, granted scopes, tenant, expiry, revocation and tested canary

flows.label: Radio · video · Spotify
flows.what_works: Local audio/video file selection and an official Spotify link embed in the public source, without account linking
steps: Choose owned or authorized local media
Preview locally through browser controls
Review Spotify official embed eligibility and rights
Enable live channels or broadcasting only after licensed sources and playback QA
missing: Verified provider session for extended features
Validated public playback on all surfaces
not_allowed: Treat a Spotify link as account authorization
flows.receipt: Content asset hash, license, player/browser QA result, provider rights

flows.label: Android · desktop · mini app
flows.what_works: Shared web source projections and preview links; device-control capability has not been independently verified in this public UI
steps: Use public World/mini app preview
Identify actual device and consented permissions
Test read-only system health via native authorized adapter
Require owner presence/STOP and bounded reversible lease for any effect
missing: Native APK release identity and signature evidence
not_allowed: Claim APK installed from web link
flows.receipt: Signed app build + device permission grant + before/after + STOP and rollback

flows.label: Wallet · NFT · 8x8 Coin
flows.what_works: Catalog exploration, public chain reading when allowed, source-only NFT and vault candidate views
steps: Separate chain-read functions from signing and funds movement
Validate user 8x8 identity and wallet ownership externally
Review contract provenance and simulated transactions
Unlock signing only through separately approved signer, chain and tenant-specific grant
flows.receipt: Chain ID + tx hash after user-approved write, otherwise read-only receipt

missing_access_states.label: Source exists, not running
missing_access_states.remedy: Inspect deploy/build gate and verify a reachable signed endpoint before marking active

missing_access_states.label: Endpoint unavailable
missing_access_states.remedy: Review authorized status/logs and use a local read-only fallback; retry with bounds

missing_access_states.label: No verified login
missing_access_states.remedy: Use the provider's official OAuth or consented on-device broker when deployed; never enter secrets here

missing_access_states.label: Missing permission
missing_access_states.remedy: Explain exact requested scope and user-owned revocation path; do not silently expand

missing_access_states.label: Provider credits or rate limit
missing_access_states.remedy: Stop external calls, preserve draft, offer local/open alternative and optional explicit provider billing

missing_access_states.label: Eligibility prohibits action
missing_access_states.remedy: Disable restricted venue and offer compliant research, paper mode, or independently eligible alternative

missing_access_states.label: Security or test gate failed
missing_access_states.remedy: Keep current production unchanged; review named failing CI and fix without removing provenance

missing_access_states.label: Physical access not granted
missing_access_states.remedy: Read-only planning until owner-approved native permission and bounded STOP-preemptible lease
